checks.message:
The input was expected to not match the regular expression /186_?000|totalPrice\s*\?\?|totalPrice\s*\|\|/. Input:

'import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";\n' +
  'import { router, useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";\n' +
  'import { useIsFocused } from "expo-router/react-navigation";\n' +
  'import React from "react";\n' +
  'import { useForm, useWatch } from "react-hook-form";\n' +
  'import { ScrollView, View } from "react-native";\n' +
  'import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";\n' +
  'import BouncyPressable from "@/components/common/BouncyPressable";\n' +
  'import { Form, FormField, FormMessage } from "@/components/common/Form";\n' +
  'import Keypad, { type KeypadState } from "@/components/common/Keypad";\n' +
  'import Text from "@/components/common/Text";\n' +
  'import { Button, ButtonText } from "@/components/ui/button";\n' +
  'import {\n' +
  '\tformatCashDigits,\n' +
  '\tgetCashQuickAmounts,\n' +
  '} from "@/lib/cashier/cash-input";\n' +
  'import { cashInputTheme } from "@/lib/cashier/cash-input-theme";\n' +
  'import { formatRp } from "@/lib/utils";\n' +
  'import {\n' +
  '\ttype CashInputSchema,\n' +
  '\tcreateCashInputSchema,\n' +
  '\tparseCashAmount,\n' +
  '\tparseCashRouteAmount,\n' +
  '} from "@/schema/cashier/cash-input";\n' +
  '\n' +
  'function CashInputForm({\n' +
  '\ttotalPrice,\n' +
  '\tinitialValue,\n' +
  '}: {\n' +
  '\ttotalPrice: number | null;\n' +
  '\tinitialValue: string;\n' +
  '}) {\n' +
  '\tconst focused = useIsFocused();\n' +
  '\tconst insets = useSafeAreaInsets();\n' +
  '\tconst active = React.useRef(false);\n' +
  '\tconst submitting = React.useRef(false);\n' +
  '\tconst form = useForm<CashInputSchema>({\n' +
  '\t\tresolver: zodResolver(createCashInputSchema(totalPrice)),\n' +
  '\t\tdefaultValues: { value: initialValue },\n' +
  '\t});\n' +
  '\tconst value = useWatch({ control: form.control, name: "value" }) ?? "";\n' +
  '\tconst displayValue = formatCashDigits(value);\n' +
  '\tconst [amountWidth, setAmountWidth] = React.useState<number | null>(null);\n' +
  '\t// Keep the Figma 32px size for normal values. A conservative Inter glyph\n' +
  '\t// budget also keeps 16-digit amounts readable on web, where native fitting\n' +
  '\t// is unavailable. Measure the real container rather than the device width.\n' +
  '\tconst amountFontSize =\n' +
  '\t\tamountWidth === null\n' +
  '\t\t\t? 32\n' +
  '\t\t\t: Math.min(32, (amountWidth - 4) / (displayValue.length * 0.7 + 1.4));\n' +
  '\tconst amount = parseCashAmount(value);\n' +
  '\tconst isValid =\n' +
  '\t\tfocused &&\n' +
  '\t\ttotalPrice !== null &&\n' +
  '\t\tamount !== null &&\n' +
  '\t\tamount > 0 &&\n' +
  '\t\tamount >= totalPrice;\n' +
  '\n' +
  '\tReact.useEffect(() => {\n' +
  '\t\tactive.current = focused;\n' +
  '\t\treturn () => {\n' +
  '\t\t\tactive.current = false;\n' +
  '\t\t};\n' +
  '\t}, [focused]);\n' +
  '\n' +
  '\tReact.useEffect(() => {\n' +
  '\t\tif (totalPrice === null) {\n' +
  '\t\t\tform.setError("value", {\n' +
  '\t\t\t\tmessage: "Total pembayaran belum tersedia. Kembali ke pesanan.",\n' +
  '\t\t\t});\n' +
  '\t\t}\n' +
  '\t}, [form, totalPrice]);\n' +
  '\n' +
  '\tconst setValue = React.useCallback<\n' +
  '\t\tReact.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<KeypadState>>\n' +
  '\t>(\n' +
  '\t\t(next) => {\n' +
  '\t\t\tif (!active.current) return;\n' +
  '\t\t\tconst previous = form.getValues("value") || null;\n' +
  '\t\t\tconst updated = typeof next === "function" ? next(previous) : next;\n' +
  '\t\t\tform.setValue("value", updated ?? "", { shouldDirty: true });\n' +
  '\t\t\tif (totalPrice !== null) form.clearErrors("value");\n' +
  '\t\t},\n' +
  '\t\t[form, totalPrice],\n' +
  '\t);\n' +
  '\n' +
  '\tfunction handleContinue(data: CashInputSchema) {\n' +
  '\t\tconst received = parseCashAmount(data.value);\n' +
  '\t\tif (\n' +
  '\t\t\t!active.current ||\n' +
  '\t\t\tsubmitting.current ||\n' +
  '\t\t\tform.getValues("value") !== data.value ||\n' +
  '\t\t\ttotalPrice === null ||\n' +
  '\t\t\treceived === null ||\n' +
  '\t\t\treceived <= 0 ||\n' +
  '\t\t\treceived < totalPrice\n' +
  '\t\t) {\n' +
  '\t\t\treturn;\n' +
  '\t\t}\n' +
  '\t\tsubmitting.current = true;\n' +
  '\t\ttry {\n' +
  '\t\t\trouter.replace({\n' +
  '\t\t\t\tpathname: "/cart/input-money-confirm",\n' +
  '\t\t\t\tparams: { value: received, totalPrice },\n' +
  '\t\t\t});\n' +
  '\t\t} catch {\n' +
  '\t\t\tsubmitting.current = false;\n' +
  '\t\t\tform.setError("value", {\n' +
  '\t\t\t\tmessage: "Tidak bisa membuka konfirmasi. Coba lagi.",\n' +
  '\t\t\t});\n' +
  '\t\t}\n' +
  '\t}\n' +
  '\n' +
  '\treturn (\n' +
  '\t\t<View className="flex-1 bg-background" style={cashInputTheme}>\n' +
  '\t\t\t<ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ flexGrow: 1 }} bounces={false}>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t<View\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tclassName="flex-1 items-center px-4"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ paddingTop: 105, paddingBottom: 24, minHeight: 177 }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t<View\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="w-full items-center gap-2"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tonLayout={({ nativeEvent }) => {\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif (nativeEvent.layout.width > 4) {\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsetAmountWidth(nativeEvent.layout.width);\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t}}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t<View\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ maxWidth: "100%" }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<Text\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="shrink-0 text-muted"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tw="medium"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ fontSize: amountFontSize, lineHeight: 48 }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tRp\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</Text>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<Text\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="shrink text-foreground"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tw="medium"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ fontSize: amountFontSize, lineHeight: 48 }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tnumberOfLines={1}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tadjustsFontSizeToFit\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tminimumFontScale={0.45}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t{displayValue}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</Text>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t<Form {...form}>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<FormField\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcontrol={form.control}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tname="value"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\trender={() => <FormMessage />}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t/>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t</Form>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t<View className="gap-3 bg-surface pb-3">\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t<View\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="flex-row items-center justify-center"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ height: 39 }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t{getCashQuickAmounts(totalPrice).map((quickAmount) => (\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<BouncyPressable\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tkey={quickAmount}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-white"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ height: 39, paddingHorizontal: 25 }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tonPress={() => setValue(String(quickAmount))}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tdisabled={!focused}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tripple\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\thapticType="light"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\taccessibilityRole="button"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\taccessibilityLabel={`Isi uang ${formatRp(quickAmount)}`}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<Text\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsize="small"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName="text-subtle"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{ lineHeight: 14.4 }}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tRp {formatCashDigits(String(quickAmount))}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</Text>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</BouncyPressable>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\t))}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t<Keypad\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tstate={[value || null, setValue]}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tcontrolled\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tnullable\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tmaxLength={16}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tappearance="cashier"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t/>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t\t\t</ScrollView>\n' +
  '\t\t\t<View\n' +
  '\t\t\t\tclassName="bg-surface"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\tstyle={{\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tpaddingTop: 10,\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tpaddingBottom: 30 + insets.bottom,\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tpaddingLeft: 20 + insets.left,\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tpaddingRight: 20 + insets.right,\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t}}\n' +
  '\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t<Button\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tsize="xl"\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tisDisabled={!isValid}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tstyle={{\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\topacity: !isValid ? 0.5 : 1,\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tpointerEvents: !isValid ? "none" : "auto",\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t}}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\tonPress={() => form.handleSubmit(handleContinue)()}\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t<ButtonText size="lg" style={{ lineHeight: 19.2 }}>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t\tBayar\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t\t</ButtonText>\n' +
  '\t\t\t\t</Button>\n' +
  '\t\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t\t</View>\n' +
  '\t);\n' +
  '}\n' +
  '\n' +
  'export default function InputKas() {\n' +
  '\tconst params = useLocalSearchParams();\n' +
  '\tconst totalPrice = parseCashRouteAmount(params.totalPrice);\n' +
  '\tconst initialAmount = parseCashRouteAmount(params.value);\n' +
  '\n' +
  '\treturn (\n' +
  '\t\t<CashInputForm\n' +
  '\t\t\tkey={JSON.stringify([params.totalPrice ?? null, params.value ?? null])}\n' +
  '\t\t\ttotalPrice={totalPrice}\n' +
  '\t\t\tinitialValue={initialAmount === null ? "" : String(initialAmount)}\n' +
  '\t\t/>\n' +
  '\t);\n' +
  '}\n'
